=== usage --watch
$ orion-node usage --watch

 ◆ Usage  what apps cost right now                                   ● live 3 s window
 ╭ Apps ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── by CPU ╮
 │ NAME          CPU                       MEMORY                 NET rx / tx         │
 │ nginx      ━━━━━╸──────── 4.1%   ╸─────── 86 MB      1.2 MB / 3.4 MB               │
 │ postgresql ━━━╸────────── 2.8%   ━━━───── 412 MB     -                             │
 │ api        ━╸──────────── 1.2%   ━╸────── 204 MB     320 KB / 90 KB                │
 │ redis      ────────────── 0.2%   ──────── 31 MB      12 KB / 8 KB                  │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 measured from outside: processes, systemd units and containers. - means unknown.

  s  sort   q  quit

--- notes
NOTE Pick from what exists: Discover becomes a selectable table (bubbles/table). Enter adds the selection to the config using the same code as setup.
NOTE Usage is live: Bars update in place every few seconds. Without --watch it samples twice and prints once.
NOTE Unknown is not zero: A value that cannot be measured shows -, never an empty bar.
